figure.title: Company-reported task measures with separate denominators
figure.description: Two rows keep OpenAI's rounded retrospective task measures separate. Previously unsolved tasks were 198 of 898 total tasks, or 22 percent. OpenAI reports that 93 percent of board-discussed tasks came from that set, using a different denominator.
figure.claim: OpenAI reports that a previously unsolved task set represented 22 percent of all tasks and 93 percent of board-discussed tasks.
figure.doesNotProve: No shared axis is used because the measures have different denominators. The records do not establish causation, uplift, settled intent, a production-wide result, or independent replication.
transformations: Do not place 22 percent and 93 percent on a shared quantitative axis, divide the values, calculate uplift, or imply causation.
Give each reported measure its own row with an explicit denominator field.
Record the unavailable public count behind the board-discussed denominator as not reported.
figure.uncertainty: OpenAI reports rounded percentages with different denominators. Public counts behind the 93 percent value, uncertainty intervals, and independent replication are unavailable in the reviewed record.
